mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.category_id, p.title, p.summary, p.content, p.tags, p.key_points, p.learning_directions, p.author_id, p.is_published, p.view_count, p.is_indexed_in_rag, p.indexed_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.name AS category_name, c.section AS category_section FROM posts p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (category_id, title, summary, key_points, learning_directions, content, tags, author_id, is_published) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{keyPoints}, #{learningDirections}, #{content}, #{tags}, #{authorId}, #{isPublished})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, key_points = #{keyPoints}, learning_directions = #{learningDirections}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET is_indexed_in_rag = #{isIndexed}, indexed_at = CASE WHEN #{isIndexed} = TRUE THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filename}, '%')
AND id != #{excludePostId}
